== frame after_killed_child cursor=2,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'stty raw -echo; kill -KILL $$'
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@2 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame alive cursor=5,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'stty raw -echo; kill -KILL $$'
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo alive
|alive
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@2 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
